export_controls.text:
Trump wants to get rid of the #CHIPSAct? All this will do is guarantee America loses its technological advantage and long-term competitiveness in AI.

America First? This is Trump again putting China First. He just doesn’t care. #JointAddress

deepseek.reason: The statement discusses the CHIPS Act and AI competitiveness, not export restrictions on overseas access.
deepseek.confidence_reason: Chip investment is explicitly irrelevant to export controls under the rubric.
